question: Which finger measure governs the fashioning of the limbs of ritual images?
premises: Ritual images have limbs that must be proportioned.
The text specifies the body-derived finger as the measure.
The emphatic eva restricts the measure to this standard.
inference: The limbs of images must be fashioned using only the body-derived finger measure.
plain_english: One should fashion the limbs of the image using only the finger measure derived from the body.
